component.text:
.
Langkah 1 Define a pool of global addresses to be used for overload translation.

kolam ip natnama awal-ip akhir-ip{netmask netmask| panjang awalanpanjang awalan}
Langkah 2 Define a standard access list permitting the addresses that should be translated.

daftar aksesnomor daftar aksesizinsumber[sumber-wildcard]
Langkah 3 Establish overload translation, specifying the access list and pool defined in prior steps.

ip nat di dalam daftar sumbernomor daftar akseskolamnamakelebihan muatan
Langkah 4 Identify the inside interface.

antarmukaketik nomor
ip nat di dalam
Langkah 5 Identify the outside interface.

antarmukaketik nomor
ip nat di luar

Define a pool of public IPv4 addresses under the pool name NAT-POOL2.
R2(config)# ip nat pool NAT-POOL2 209.165.200.226 209.165.200.240 netmask 255.255.255.224

Define which addresses are eligible to be translated.
R2(config)#daftar akses 1 izin 192.168.0.0 0.0.255.255

Bind NAT-POOL2 with ACL 1.
R2(config)#ip nat di dalam daftar sumber 1 kumpulan NAT-POOL2 kelebihan beban

Identify interface serial 0/0/0 as an inside NAT interface.
R2(config)# antarmuka Serial0/0/0
R2(config-if)# ip nat di dalam

Identify interface serial 0/1/0 as the outside NAT interface.
R2(config)#antarmuka Serial0/1/0
R2(config-if)#ip nat di luar
